name: Dynamic Tags for Elementor
author: Mustafa Kamal hossain

sections.description:
Dynamic Tags for Elementor enables rich dynamic content workflows in Elementor Free by registering custom Dynamic Tags groups and tags.

Use it for:

  • Dynamic text in headings, text editors, labels, and badges.
  • Dynamic links in buttons, images, menus, and URL fields.
  • Dynamic image sources for media widgets.
  • Conditional-like outputs using boolean/context tags (1 / 0).

The plugin adds dedicated DTE groups:

  • Post (DTE)
  • Archive (DTE)
  • Site (DTE)
  • Media (DTE)
  • Author (DTE)
  • Taxonomy (DTE)
  • WooCommerce (DTE)
  • ACF (DTE)

It also includes a WordPress admin page with:

  • Quick start instructions
  • Dependency status (Elementor Pro / ACF / WooCommerce / WPML-Polylang)
  • Searchable Tag Directory with field type and slug references

Included Tags (Current Set)

Post (DTE)

  • Post Title
  • Post Date
  • Post Excerpt
  • Post URL
  • Post Content
  • Post Parent
  • Post Status
  • Post Type
  • Are Comments Allowed
  • Is 404
  • Is Home
  • Is Front Page
  • Is Singular
  • Is Feed
  • Is Current User Author Of Post
  • Is Post In Category
  • Is Post In List
  • Number Posts Query
  • WooCommerce Is Featured Product (requires WooCommerce)

Archive (DTE)

  • Archive Title

Site (DTE)

  • Site Title
  • Site Tagline
  • Site URL
  • Current URL
  • Current Language (WPML/Polylang aware)
  • Current User Can
  • Cookies
  • Session
  • Server Variables
  • Widget Content

Media (DTE)

  • Featured Image
  • Site Logo
  • Site Icon

Author (DTE)

  • Author Name
  • User/Author Image URL
  • User Role
  • Current User ID
  • Current User Display Name
  • Current User Email
  • Current User Registration Date

Taxonomy (DTE)

  • Current Term Name
  • Current Term Description
  • Current Term Image

WooCommerce (DTE)

  • WooCommerce Is Featured Product
  • Product Price
  • Product Sale Price
  • Product SKU
  • Product Stock Status
  • Product Categories
  • Product Rating
  • Product Add To Cart URL

ACF (DTE)

  • ACF Repeater
  • ACF Gallery First Image
  • ACF Relationship First Post Title
  • ACF Taxonomy Term Name
  • ACF Date Picker Formatted

Dependencies

  • Required: Elementor
  • Optional integrations:
    • Advanced Custom Fields for ACF Repeater tag
    • WooCommerce for featured product tag
    • WPML / Polylang for current language behavior

Usage

  1. Edit a page/template with Elementor.
  2. Click the Dynamic Tags icon next to a supported field.
  3. Choose a tag under one of the (DTE) groups.
  4. Configure tag controls (if available).

Tip: For quick tag discovery, open WP Admin → Dynamic Tags and use the search field in the Tag Directory.

Security

Tag outputs are sanitized where appropriate before rendering. Still, always validate custom field/cookie/session data according to your project requirements.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dynamic-tags-for-elementor directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor editor and click the Dynamic Tags icon on supported fields.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. This plugin is specifically designed to provide dynamic functionality to the Free version of Elementor.

Will it work if I upgrade to Pro later?

Yes. This plugin uses its own group, so it will coexist peacefully with Elementor Pro tags.

Why do some tags return empty output?

Some tags depend on context or plugins. Example: ACF Repeater requires valid ACF repeater field names, WooCommerce featured tag requires WooCommerce and a product context.

Where can I see all available tags quickly?

Go to WP Admin → Dynamic Tags. The Tag Directory includes groups, field types, slugs, and notes, plus search.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Added Taxonomy (DTE) group tags: Current Term Name, Current Term Description, and Current Term Image.
  • Expanded Author (DTE) with Current User ID, Current User Display Name, Current User Email, and Current User Registration Date.
  • Updated loader/admin tag mappings and documentation lists to reflect new Taxonomy and Author coverage.

1.0.5

  • Added ACF (DTE) group coverage with new tags: ACF Gallery First Image, ACF Relationship First Post Title, ACF Taxonomy Term Name, and ACF Date Picker Formatted.
  • Kept ACF Repeater under the ACF group and updated tag references in the admin directory.
  • Continued Plugin Check hardening updates in recently touched dynamic tag files.
  • Added: Added other plugin submenu page for plugin admin settings.

1.0.4.1

  • Changed: remove unwanted text file form plugin before deploy.

1.0.4

  • Added dedicated WooCommerce (DTE) group in the tag picker.
  • Added WooCommerce product tags: Product Price, Product Sale Price, Product SKU, Product Stock Status, Product Categories, Product Rating, and Product Add To Cart URL.
  • Updated admin Tag Directory and tag reference lists to include WooCommerce tag coverage.
  • Improved Plugin Check compatibility with additional sanitization, output escaping, and query-handling improvements.

1.0.3

  • Added 4 new post tags: Post Content, Post Parent, Post Status, and Post Type.
  • Added many utility/context tags from the extended set (cookies, session, server vars, current URL/language, user capability/role, condition checks, query count, widget content, Woo featured, ACF repeater).
  • Improved plugin admin page with Quick Start, Dependency Status, full Tag Directory, and live tag search/filter.
  • Expanded plugin readme with updated features, grouped tag listing, usage docs, dependencies, and FAQ.
  • Added/registered Site URL, Site Logo, and Site Icon tags for URL/media use-cases in Elementor.
  • Fixed Plugin Check warnings for output escaping, sanitization/unslashing of server input, and prepared SQL handling.
  • Removed direct DB query in Widget Content controls and replaced with WordPress API + object cache.
  • Added targeted PHPCS ignore for core the_content hook naming warning.

1.0.2

  • Added many new DTE tags across Post, Site, Media, and Author groups.
  • Added Site URL, Site Logo, and Site Icon tags.
  • Added utility and condition tags (context checks, server/session/cookie/user capability, etc.).
  • Added admin Tag Directory with grouped references and dependency status.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added a suite of 9 standard dynamic tags.

screenshots.caption: Welcome banner and success message after activation – clean onboarding screen with plugin branding and confirmation that dynamic content is now enabled in Elementor Free.
Dynamic tags dropdown in the Elementor Heading widget – select from Post Title (DTE), Post Excerpt (DTE), Site Title (DTE), Current User Can (DTE), and many other post, site, and author tags.
Dynamic tags dropdown in the Elementor Image widget editor – choose from Featured Image (DTE), Site Logo (DTE), Site Icon (DTE), and more.
Link tags in action – selecting Post URL, Site Url (DTE), Current Url (DTE) etc directly in the Elementor editor for dynamic image link.
Quick Start and Dependency Status section in the plugin settings – shows how to use dynamic tags and checks for required plugins like Elementor, ACF, and WooCommerce.
Comprehensive Tag Directory in the admin area – searchable list of all available dynamic tags grouped by category (Post, WooCommerce, Author, etc.), with slugs, field types, and notes.
